snippet.title: We WASTED a YEAR making the WRONG game! | Animalkind Devlog #0
snippet.description:
Hi! We're making a video game, it's called Animalkind, and this is a story about how we actually weren't originally making this game at all. A story of heartache and failure, and picking ourselves up from the ground and starting all over from scratch. We spent a year, OVER a year, actually, making another game entirely, and it took us that entire time to realize that we needed to change course entirely. This is the story about how we went from making a hardcore survival game to a cute, cozy sandbox. This is our first Devlog, with more to come soon, so I hope you enjoy our journey together.

And if you enjoy that journey, be sure to follow us everywhere else:

✨Our Steam page: store.steampowered.com/app/2997840/Animalkind/
✨Discord: discord.gg/animalkind
✨Twitter: x.com/playuncommon
✨Mailing list: bit.ly/uncommonYT

Written by: Austin Hourigan & Brian Guenther
Edited by: Austin Hourigan
Music by: Audio Network
